items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stump was my man too. We used to hang out.

ctx.x: Stump [Harry T. Saunders]. Yeah, Stump was my man too. We used to hang out. Stump is a lot younger than me. Stump is maybe after I left. I’m not sure if he was there that much before I left. I can’t remember. But I remember Stump. I remember him playing with Lady . . .
